rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial pattern for doing something despite a warning or bad consequence.

example.english: You said there would be traffic, but I will go regardless.
example.jyutping: nei5 waa6 wui5 sak1 ce1 ngo5 ziu3 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for “regardless” in the sense of proceeding whatever the preceding circumstances or discussion may be.

example.english: Regardless of what you say, I’m going.
example.traditional: 你講咩都好，我點都會去。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 me1 dou1 hou2 ngo5 dim2 dou1 wui5 heoi3

rows.note: Use this discourse marker for “anyway” when moving on to the decision or conclusion, rather than stressing a specific warning.

example.english: Regardless, we’ll set off tomorrow as planned.
example.jyutping: zung2 zi1 ting1 jat6 ziu3 gai3 waak6 ceot1 faat3
